i.norm: When {@link Md5Crypt#apr1Crypt(byte[], String)} is given a null salt, the method generates one for us from a (here, deterministically mocked) SecureRandom and produces an Apache "$apr1$" prefixed MD5 hash. With the mocked randomness the generated salt is always "........", so the full hash for an all-zero 8-byte key is fixed and reproducible.
